verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Justworks PEO provides health insurance plan quotes and requires notifying prior health insurance providers when transitioning (docs-4, docs-8, docs-18, docs-34), implying it administers benefits as part of its PEO offering, but there is no direct documentation of the enrollment workflow or of deductions syncing to payroll runs. missing for 10: explicit enrollment management flow, deduction-to-payroll sync mechanics, employee self-service enrollment evidence, and any independent/hands-on confirmation.
